consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance of the Grateful Dead on this night was uneven, with many noting significant vocal issues and lyric flubs. Despite the struggles, some reviewers appreciated the novelty of attempting a Beatles cover and highlighted moments of creativity in the jamming.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 75 reviews + -0.5 sentiment: While there were some enjoyable moments and a unique setlist, the overall performance quality was often criticized, leading to a lower enthusiasm adjustment.
